description: Add native support for Server-Sent Events (SSE) to enable real-time, unidirectional streaming from server to client. This feature should allow FastAPI applications to stream events to clients using the standard SSE protocol, with proper content type headers and event formatting. The implementation should integrate seamlessly with FastAPI's existing routing and response systems.
functional_requirements: Create a new SSE response class that properly formats events with 'text/event-stream' content type
Implement route handlers that can yield events in the SSE format (data, event, id, retry fields)
Add support for both synchronous and asynchronous event generators in SSE endpoints
Ensure proper connection handling and cleanup when clients disconnect from SSE streams
Update OpenAPI documentation generation to properly document SSE endpoints
Include comprehensive examples showing different SSE use cases (simple events, named events, reconnection)
